description: This file defines the RedisGatewayListProvider class, which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface to provide a list of gateway URIs from a Redis-backed membership table for Orleans. It interacts with the RedisMembershipTable to initialize and retrieve member entries and filters active silos with proxy ports to generate gateway URIs.

classes.name: RedisGatewayListProvider
classes.description: A provider that supplies the list of gateway URIs by querying a Redis-based membership table for active silo endpoints with proxy ports.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves active gateway URIs from the Redis membership table, initializing the table if necessary.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the Redis membership table for gateway list provider use.
